content.comment_body: Hello, We are working with a 1.5-year-old [product_name] system. One section contains a [product_name], an [product_name], and a [product_name]. The switch appears to be malfunctioning: all four LEDs remain continuously lit. When replaced by an external switch, the system functions properly. Could connecting it to a Power over Ethernet port have caused this switch to fail?
That's a possibility. You could also contact [company_name] directly through their support request service for further assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reported a failure with a [product_name] component, where all LEDs are persistently on. Replacing this component with a different switch resolved the issue, implying the fault is with the original device. The user is questioning whether a connection to a Power over Ethernet port might be responsible and seeks clarification from the forum community.
